owner_calls.question: Peter's last stage is The Avengers (from Avengers: Infinity War). After Strange's spell in Spider-Man: No Way Home erases everyone's memory of him, he works alone in Spider-Man: Brand New Day; the wiki lists the Avengers as a former affiliation. Should a departure be recorded?
options: Keep as is (The Avengers stays his last stage)
Add ["Independent", "Spider-Man: No Way Home"] (the spell ends his place in the Avengers)
owner_calls.evidence: Infobox affiliation reads Avengers (formerly). In No Way Home Strange's spell makes the world forget Peter Parker; in Brand New Day he works alone, and Yelena Belova turns him away because the New Avengers are busy elsewhere.
